name: chess_capture
text: A person sits on the front portion of a stool facing a chessboard, both feet planted. Capture an opposing piece. First lift the opponent from the centre square and set it off the board on the left edge of the table. Then pick up your own near piece, move it diagonally to the emptied square, release it and return the hand to the lap. Keep hips supported on the stool, bend at the waist only as needed, and keep the inactive hand low on the thigh.
